sourceLineage.origin: Southern Company official site / Q2 2026 earnings

observations: Southern Company reports Q2 2026 earnings of $1.2B/$1.03 per share versus $0.9B/$0.80 a year earlier.
Vogtle Units 3 & 4 are presented as supplying carbon-free nuclear power to more than one million homes and businesses in Georgia.
risks: capital intensity and regulatory recovery remain material execution dependencies
single official-source pass does not establish demand durability or valuation
unknowns: current load-growth split attributable to data centers versus other demand
forward capex/recovery schedule and customer affordability effects
